rows.note: STUDENT A, STUDENT B · crew picked: STUDENT A

rows.step: 1.0 a press on ST-02 opens the grading pop-up
1.1 "Failed on" starts at today (23 Sep 26)
1.2 + records one failure, dated today, listed under the counter
1.3 the "Failed on" box takes a typed day (10/09/2026) and the pop-up stays open
1.4 the second + lands on the CHANGED day: ST-02 23/09/26, ST-02X 10/09/26
1.5 the ball wears two red ticks
1.6 − with two failures [23/09 recorded first, 10/09 recorded second] leaves
1.6a − takes one failure back (count 2 → 1)
1.7 + again (box still 10/09) → two failures
1.8 Escape closes the pop-up
2.1 one chip per failure, worst event first: ST-02, ST-02X, ACG-01
2.2 the total counts FAILURES (3), not events (2)
2.3 hovering ST-02X shows its day in a bubble (10/09/26)
rows.said: ST-02X Checklist Introduction STUDENT A: 2nd failure of 2 on ST-02 Failed on: 10/09/26

rows.step: 3.1 the Failures title opens the full list, one row + date box per failure
rows.said: [{"chip":"ST-02","d":"2026-09-23","t":"ST-02 1st failure · Checklist Introduction"},{"chip":"ST-02X","d":"2026-09-10","t":"ST-02X 2nd failure · Checklist Introduction"},{"chip":"ACG-01","d":"2026-09-23","t":"ACG-01 1st failure · Course Introduction and Aircraft Overview"}]

rows.step: 3.2 re-dating ST-02X in the list re-dates its chip (12/09/26)
rows.said: box=2026-09-12 chip title="ST-02X — 2nd failure on ST-02 · 12/09/26"

rows.step: 3.3 an emptied box leaves the failure UNDATED, not deleted (3 rows, 3 chips, ACG-01 "date not recorded")
rows.said: box="" rows ["ST-02=2026-09-23","ST-02X=2026-09-12","ACG-01=(empty)"] chip "ACG-01 — 1st failure on ACG-01 · date not recorded"

rows.step: 3.4 Escape closes the full list
3.5 what is stored for STUDENT A (read-only)
3.6 the ST-02 pop-up list reads the re-dated day (ST-02X 12/09/26)
4.1 picking STUDENT B: the Failures card is B's (none)
4.2 pop-up now titled
4.3 B's card shows only B's failure (ACG-02, 1 fail)
4.4 B's chip bubble names B and B's day
rows.said: ACG-02 Propulsion System STUDENT B: 1st failure of 1 on ACG-02 Failed on: 23/09/26

rows.step: 4.5 B's full list is B's
4.6 back to A: A's record is back (ST-02, ST-02X, ACG-01)
5.1 ST-02 marked N.A.: no red ticks while N.A.
5.2 the Failures card while ST-02 is N.A.
5.3 + on an N.A. event is refused (count unchanged)
5.4 …and its refusal "“ST-02” is marked N.A., so it cannot be failed." is VISIBLE somewhere on screen
